title: Prospective randomized study on the effect of local muscle anaesthesia in the percutaneous therap of kidney stones
summary: Study investigating the effectiveness of local anaesthesia on postoperative pain, use of analgestics, and quality of life after percutaneous therapy of kidney stones

interventions.name: In addition to a standardized anaesthesia protocol, the intervention group receives a modified procedure consisting of local anathesia of the M. erector spinae (level TH8) with 30ml Ropivacain 0.375%. Local anesthetics will be administered by an experienced member of the faculty of the department of
The control arm receives a standradized anaesthesia protocol and a placebo injection of the fascia of the M. erector spinae (level TH8)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
symptomatic renal calculus >10mm
Exclusion criteria:
language barrier, acute urosepsis, dementia, legal counsel
